name: Extra Transfer [Psionic]
body:
You can use transfer wounds more often.

Prerequisite: Transfer wounds or sickening touch class feature.

Benefit: You can use transfer wounds or sickening touch two additional times per day.

Special: If you have both transfer wounds and sickening touch, choose which ability this feat affects when you take this feat. You may take this feat multiple times, once for each ability.
